title: Thundertree · Area 6 · Ruined store
reveal: When the webbed ruin is seen

sourceRecords.title: Thundertree 6 · Ruined store and webs
read: White strands cross the lane to a broken store. The building looks empty from outside, though its walls offer plenty of shadows.

The strands cross the lane as well as the building, making the approach itself worth examining. Your light catches some threads more readily than the shadows behind them. You can study the webbing from clear ground or decide how much of the lane you want to cross.

brief: Ruined general store/workshop at village junction, part of its TILE roof intact. Lane to north climbs hill; sheets of white spider silk stretch across lane from store to trees north of road. Dense north-side thickets. TWO giant spiders hidden on inner walls must remain out of view. Exterior approach, no cocooned body revealed through masonry, no endless webs blanketing entire village.
